何大清也一脸疑惑的看向何雨柱，刚要说什么，王野就说：“何大爷，你的钱是怎样寄给我柱子哥的？”

何大清想都没想，就说：“我是寄给易中海，让他转交给柱子的，当年他们还那么...”还没说完，何大清就察觉了其中的问题，转话就问王野：“你是说，易中海贪了我给柱子的钱？也不对呀！易中海工资可不低，犯不上为了十块八块的冒这么大险。”

王野说：“何大爷，我有一个猜想，对不对的，你和柱子哥先听听。”

何大清说：“你说，没事儿。”

“何大爷说当年你离开四九城，是易大爷帮忙的，说是有人要举报你。要举报就是还没举报，没举报就能让易大爷知道，无外乎知道是谁要举报，或者听谁说了要举报。不论哪一种都不会查不出来，好歹问问就能知道。”

“可是易大爷却说没查出来，那就是说明，他不想让你知道是谁要举报你对吧？”

何大清点了点头，王野接着说：“如果说要举报你的人是易中海本人呢？是不是就合理了？”

何大清反问道：“我和易中海关系还不错，他为什么举报我呀？”

王野继续问：“何大爷你当时办这些关系，是不是通过易中海办的？”

“是呀，怎么了？”

“那花了多少钱，是不是也通过易中海？”

“是呀！”

“那他从中捞了多少，你知道吗？”

“不会吧？”

“如果易中海从中捞了不少，他最怕谁？”

“那肯定是我呀！我要是跟他一对账，就全明白了。”

“这不就明白了吗，开始的时候应该是怕事情败露，干脆逼着你远走他乡，这件事儿就人不知鬼不觉了。”

何大清觉得王野说的可能性很大，就又问：“就算是这样，他为什么还要贪我给柱子的十来块钱呀？”

“我猜这是后话了，易中海没儿没女，如果柱子哥和你老死不相往来，再加上平时给柱子哥点儿小恩小惠，以柱子哥的性格，会不会给易中海养老呀？”

“这傻柱子，肯定会死心塌地的给易中海养老。”

“这不就通了。”

何雨柱想要说什么，看见何大清在那里思考着什么，也就没有张嘴。过了一会儿，何大清脸上越来越难看，怒喊一声：“他易中海怎么敢的！”

王野赶紧说：“何大爷你先消消气，这没什么想不通的，现在这社会吃绝户的不在少数吧？易中海也是怕。”

“他怕就能算计我们家，这么多年，我跟个傻子一样被他耍的团团转，我还舔着脸叫柱子傻柱呢！我才是那个大傻子！”

王野：“何大爷，现在也不是生气的时候，你得合计合计接下来该怎么办？”

何大清一拍桌子：“我！我，我...”我了好几声也没有下文。

He Daqing also looked at He Yuzhu with a puzzled look. Just as he was about to say something, Wang Ye said, "Uncle He, how did you send the money to my brother Zhuzhu?"

Without thinking, He Daqing said, "I sent it to Yi Zhonghai and asked him to deliver it to Zhu Zhu. Back then, they were so..." Before he could finish, He Daqing noticed the problem and asked Wang Ye: "You mean, Yi Zhonghai embezzled the money I gave Zhu Zhu? That's not right! Yi Zhonghai's salary is not low, and he can't take such a big risk for ten or eight dollars."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle He, I have a guess. If it is correct, you and Brother Zhuzi will listen to it first."

He Daqing said: "Say, it's okay."

"Uncle He said that Uncle Yi helped you when you left Sijiu City. He said that someone wanted to report you. If you want to report, you haven't reported it yet. If you don't report, you can let Uncle Yi know. It's nothing more than knowing who wants to report, or who has said that you want to report. No matter what, you can find out by asking."

"But Uncle Yi said he didn't find out. That means he doesn't want you to know who wants to report you, right?"

He Daqing nodded, and Wang Ye continued: "What if the person who said he wanted to report you was Yi Zhonghai himself? Is it reasonable?"

He Daqing asked: "I have a good relationship with Yi Zhonghai, why did he report me?"

Wang Ye continued to ask: "Uncle He, did you manage these relationships through Yi Zhonghai?"

"Yeah, what's wrong?"

"How much did it cost? Did it also go through Yi Zhonghai?"

"Yes!"

"Do you know how much he made from it?"

"No way?"

"If Yi Zhonghai makes a lot of money from it, who is he most afraid of?"

"That must be me! If I check the account with him, I will understand everything."

"Isn't it clear? In the beginning, I was probably afraid that the matter would be exposed, so I simply forced you to go away from home, so that no one would know about it."

He Daqing felt that Wang Ye's story was very likely, so he asked again: "Even if this is the case, why is he still greedy for the ten yuan I gave Zhuzi?"

"I guess this is a thing for later. Yi Zhonghai has no children. If Brother Zhuzi and you never get in touch with each other, and you give Brother Zhuzhu some small favors, will Brother Zhuzhu have the character to support Yi Zhonghai in his old age?"

"This silly Zhuzhu will definitely give his all to provide for Yi Zhonghai."

"That makes sense."

He Yuzhu wanted to say something, but when he saw He Daqing thinking about something, he didn't open his mouth.After a while, He Daqing's face became increasingly ugly, and he shouted angrily: "How dare he, Yi Zhonghai!"

Wang Ye hurriedly said: "Uncle He, please calm down first. There is nothing unreasonable about this. There are not a few people who are desperate in this society, right? Yi Zhonghai is also afraid."

"He is afraid that he can plot against our family. For so many years, I have been played around by him like a fool. I even licked my face and called Zhu Zhu silly Zhu! I am the big fool!"

Wang Ye: "Uncle He, now is not the time to be angry. You have to figure out what to do next."

He Daqing slapped the table: "Me! I, I..." I shouted several times but nothing came out.
